description: Search the full MCP catalog for tools not in the core set. Returns matching tools with their full schemas, ready to call via tools/call. Use when the user request maps to a capability not in the core set. Keywords can be: tool name fragment (e.g. "ingest_bulk"), domain (silo, africa, vertical, piracy, creator, sports, crm, admin), or action (list, get, create, compare).
name: search_tools

outputSchema.description: Tool-specific result object. Inspect the `content` array for human-readable text and structured data.
